title: Architecture graph
description: The module graph the architecture viewer page renders. Produced from the DEPENDENCY_RULES tool's own output (dependency-cruiser JSON for TypeScript, pydeps --show-deps or an ast walk for Python) joined with the plan's Module and Interface Deltas. Enforced locally by speckit_pro_runner/architecture_graph.py (standard library); this file documents the same rules. Fail-open: a producer that cannot build a valid graph writes nothing and the viewer page is skipped.

base.description: For kind=pr: the git revision the touched set was diffed against.

touched.description: For kind=pr: node ids of modules the PR changed. Every node in the graph is one of these or within one hop of one.

tool.description: The producer that emitted the raw graph, for example dependency-cruiser or pydeps.

id.description: Repository-relative path of the module file or package, the join key for edges, touched, and deltas.

touched.description: True when the id is in scope.touched.

summary.description: The one-line delta for callers from the plan's Module and Interface Deltas line.

valid.description: False when the DEPENDENCY_RULES tool flagged the edge; the viewer draws it red.

rule.description: The violated rule or contract name when valid is false.
